relationships.description: Mayo Clinic Global Consulting advised on the planning and design of Bali International Hospital in the Sanur special economic zone. Mayo has said it acts only as a consultant and clinical knowledge partner and does not run the hospital.
relationships.evidence: The latest dated source found is the Jakarta Post of 17 March 2023, quoting a Mayo executive that Mayo is only a consultant. Bali International Hospital did not list Mayo among its international partners in its 25 April 2025 partner announcement, and no 2024 to 2026 evidence of continued advisory work was found.
